label: early-prefix trigram detector: u/c/h/o at positions 2-4 after specific tokens (l/3/p/z two back, g/3/x/l/t one back)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.017% of steps). 87% of its mass is in the original phase at t=2-4, peaking at t=3 (58% of mass); it never fires at t=0-1 and almost never on the delimiter. The current input is mostly u, c, or h (about 70% of mass), with o, g, j, w less often. It is strongly modulated by the preceding tokens: two steps back l or 3 (11x lift), one step back g, 3, x, l, or t (4-8x), and the first token l, p, or k (6x). Typical top examples: p 3 g [c], k b 3 x [u], k 3 3 g [o]. It behaves like a hashed detector for specific token combinations early in the sequence rather than one clean rule: the full conjunction gets only about 0.34 precision and 0.33 recall. The token sets alone overpredict by a lot (u/c/h/o at t=2-4 has precision 0.004), and many activations have other contexts. About 12% of the mass is weak copy-phase firing, usually when a u/c/h token from original position 2 is fed back in (e.g. c z h p 3 3 <DEL> c z [h]); the predicate does not cover this. Activation is fairly uniform (median 0.66 of max); the strongest cases are the full trigram matches like p 3 g c.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=h (+4.23), prev_tok=g (+3.79), prev_tok=x (+3.57), orig0=k (+3.43), prev2_tok=3 (+3.40), prev_tok=3 (+3.35). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-1.95), to_go=0 (-0.76).
